**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **Only MFN-type language in the document is Subparagraph 15.2 (p0220)**, requiring transiting facilities to be furnished "on terms and conditions which shall be no less favorable than those granted to another Carrier."
- **Direction check:** that obligation binds the *Terminal Parties*, listed in Subparagraph 4.1 as SingTel, TM, CWHKTI, China Telecom, KT, NTT Com, KDD and Chunghwa Telecom. Teleglobe USA Inc. is an Initial Party (p0053) but not a Terminal Party, so the MFN runs **in our favour** — exactly the preferred position, and per the rule's detection guidance it is not to be flagged.
- **Planner's candidate p0225 (Subparagraph 17.2)** merely requires Terminal Party arrangements to be "reasonable and non-discriminatory" — an even-handed constraint on the Terminal Party, not a best-terms covenant on us.
- Targeted searches for "favourable/favorable", "no less", and most-favoured-nation phrasing returned nothing obliging us to match or extend third-party terms, so there is no MFN burden on our side and nothing to delete.
